verdict.rationale: OCI documents an official CLI that matches the Console's core functionality and adds extra commands. It comes pre-configured in Cloud Shell, has install paths for Oracle Linux, macOS (including Homebrew), Windows and Linux/Unix, and supports token-based auth without a keypair. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and documentation of agent-friendly specifics such as structured output or non-interactive scripting modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The CLI provides the same core functionality as the Console, plus additional commands.
The CLI is pre-configured with your credentials and ready to use immediately from within Cloud Shell
This section contains quick installation instructions for the following environments: Oracle Linux 9, Oracle Linux 8, Oracle Linux 7, Mac OS, Windows, Linux and Unix
You can use Homebrew to install, upgrade, and uninstall the CLI on Mac OS.
To use the CLI without a keypair, you can use token-based authentication.
